bobyqa.known_bubbleverse_failure_avoided: Do not combine external matrix restarts with Cobaya/Py-BOBYQA best_of>1. Earlier Bubbleverse Q005/Q032 runs documented duplicate-restart/maxfun and singular-interpolation failure modes.

pilot.acceptable_exit: finite objective and non-negative Py-BOBYQA flag; EXIT_MAXFUN_WARNING is acceptable for bounded pilot, negative input/linear-algebra failures are not

production_frozen.globality_gate: within each arm/model/data cell, retain the best finite likelihood minimum only after all four external starts complete; negative Py-BOBYQA linear-algebra/input flags fail that start and must be preserved
production_frozen.start_rule: start 0 = frozen Q032 parent reference; starts 1-3 = deterministic bounded signed perturbations of sampled coordinates using 0.08, 0.14 and 0.20 of each finite prior span, clipped 5 percent inside hard bounds; EDE sector remains n=3; no internal multi-start layer

on_fail: Return the preserved technical failure. Do not infer failed physics. Do not silently tune science thresholds or production settings.
on_pass: Return to Result Ingestion & Routing Engine. Production campaign may then be generated without changing the frozen production numerical settings unless this preflight itself exposes a technical incompatibility.

original_decision_rule.combination_materiality: material if model-preference portability is material OR both parameter-location and contour geometry are material

contour_overlap.method: empirical weighted two-dimensional posterior/profile overlap; no Gaussian compression

final_classification.MATERIAL_SCIENTIFIC_PORTABILITY_DIFFEREN: FULL material AND materiality survives every required valid leave-one-out test
final_classification.MIXED_DATASET_CONDITIONAL: at least one valid required combination is material and at least one valid required combination is non-material
final_classification.SCIENTIFIC_DIFFERENCE_COLLAPSES: FULL and every valid leave-one-out are non-material in parameter location, have substantial contour overlap, and have portable EDE/LCDM conclusions

model_preference.portability_material_if: arms occupy different categories AND abs(DeltaChi2_A-DeltaChi2_B)>=2

parameter_location.material_if: D_H0>=1 OR D_fEDE>=1 OR at least two eligible primary cosmological coordinates have D>=1
parameter_location.weak_identification_rule: log10z_c and thetai_scf cannot by themselves make parameter-location material when fEDE is weakly identified/prior dominated.

production_frozen.seed_policy: deterministic unique seed per arm/model/combination; exact seeds generated and frozen in the production program before any production result is inspected

polychord.resume_policy: Pilot must write a non-empty PolyChord resume object and a second Cobaya invocation with resume=True and identical statistical settings must accept it. Production may only use genuine continuation from transferred PolyChord/Cobaya state.

runtime_limits.production_rule: Production workflow must use safe sub-6-hour resumable segments or independent shards; it must not be emitted as a single oversized job.
runtime_limits.v19_base_cache_policy: EXACT_CACHE_REQUIRED; cold NERSC bootstrap forbidden in Q042-PREFLIGHT-V4
runtime_limits.v4_environment_cache_reuse: PREFERRED; restore exact Q042 V4 environment cache before any cold rebuild because V4 demonstrated successful real-stack initialization before its local identity-gate failure.

scientific_question: Kan den oprindelige Q041 downstream-portabilitetstest udføres med en ny præregistreret, konvergensrobust inference-strategi, der nøjagtigt bevarer den oprindelige scientific contract — begge native Planck-arme, ΛCDM og n=3 EDE, ACT DR6 primary, ACT DR6 lensing, DESI DR2, én identisk frozen supernova-likelihood, FULL + fire leave-one-out-tests og de oprindelige materialitets-/modelpræferenceregler — uden at genbruge Q040's invaliderede science-endpoints, uden cross-arm absolute objective arithmetic og uden retroaktivt at ændre kriterier efter resultaterne?
scope: PRE_SCIENCE_PREFLIGHT_ONLY. No cosmological classification is permitted. This program validates the exact 20-cell surface, frozen runtime, bounded PolyChord transport pilots, external-start Py-BOBYQA pilots, and checkpoint/resume readability before a production campaign may be generated.
